title: zanthoxylum hillebrandii var. hiloense
intro: Zanthoxylum hillebrandii var. hiloense, commonly known as Hilo prickly ash, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate pain and treat various infections. The therapeutic actions of Hilo prickly ash include analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Zanthoxylum hillebrandii var. hiloense have been found to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its medicinal properties.
